name: World of Discoveries
description: An interactive museum that brings the history of Portuguese navigators to life. Fun and educational for all ages.
longDescription:
The World of Discoveries is an interactive museum located in Miragaia, Porto, dedicated to exploring the history of Portuguese maritime exploration. It provides an engaging presentation of the voyages and discoveries made by Portuguese navigators, aiming to educate visitors about this significant period in history through hands-on exhibits and multimedia displays.

Visitors to the World of Discoveries can expect an immersive journey through various themed areas, each focusing on different aspects of the Age of Discovery. The experience is designed to be accessible and enjoyable for a wide range of ages, offering both educational content and interactive elements. The museum is situated in Miragaia, a historic riverside district of Porto.

The World of Discoveries is a ticketed event running from April 30th to May 6th, 2026. It is suitable for families. The venue in Miragaia is accessible via local bus routes and is within walking distance from the historic Ribeira district.
